title: CA confirms ad interim appointments of 14 generals, nomination of vice admiral
summary: The Commission on Appointments (CA) on Monday confirmed the 14 ad interim appointments and one nomination of generals and flag officers of the Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP).

blocks.text: The Commission on Appointments (CA) on Monday confirmed the 14 ad interim appointments and one nomination of generals and flag officers of the Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP).
These 15 officials attended the Committee on National Defense hearing and plenary session, where their ad interim appointments and nominations were confirmed:

items: Manuel Leo Q. Gador - Brigadier General
Lilian Victoria DC Busto - Brigadier General
Gaudencio M. Lauron III - Brigadier General
Peter Edwin R. Navarro - Brigadier General
Allan Jose L. Taguba - Major General

blocks.text: During the hearing at the committee level, Santiago discussed her experience as the first female commandant of cadets at the Philippine Military Academy (PMA).
Santiago said military training should not be altered based on gender.

“Warfighting is not gender specific. So the training that we must learn should not be altered because of our gender. So I must say that it should be on par with my male colleagues,” she said. –NB, GMA News
